overloadMerges.note: The doc syntax line has no parenthesized parameter list ('Web Event : object'), so the mechanical parser produced an empty overload with no return type at all; added the documented Object return type.
overloadMerges.semanticRole: Returns an object describing the most recently triggered event linked to a web page component handled by the 4D web server (caller, eventType, and event-specific data).

constraints: Must be called in the context of a web page handled by the 4D web server.

Result properties: caller (string, server-side reference of the component that triggered the event), eventType (string; one of onblur/onfocus/onclick/onauxclick/onmouseenter/onmouseleave/onkeyup/onkeydown/onchange/unload/onload), and data (object, additional component-specific information, e.g. index for a Tabs/Data Table component, name for a Data Table column).
